title: SCEF (NUG and Major EAOs) Signals Openness to Negotiations for First Time
detail: The Steering Council for the Emergence of a Federal Democratic Union (SCEF) — the umbrella body comprising the NUG and major ethnic armed organizations including the KIO, KNU, CNF, and KNPP — said on August 5, 2026 that it is committed to pursuing negotiations, following a meeting with Thai and Philippine foreign ministers. The shift, driven partly by junta battlefield gains in Rakhine and Magway and regional diplomatic pressure, marks the first credible sign in the war's history of a possible move from pure military confrontation toward political negotiation.

media.caption: SCEF, the NUG-EAO coalition, signals openness to negotiations for the first time.

title: Junta Troops Burn Homes and Vehicles in U Yin Gyi Village, Karen State
detail: The KNU reported that junta troops entered U Yin Gyi village in Ler Doh Soe Township, Myeik-Dawei District, Karen State, on the night of August 5, 2026, burning 2 houses and 2 vehicles, as part of ongoing junta operations against the KNU's 4th Brigade area.

media.caption: Junta troops burn homes and vehicles in U Yin Gyi village, KNU 4th Brigade area, Karen State.

title: NUG/PDF Commanders Set Plans to Move Toward 'Strategic Offensive' Phase
detail: Senior PDF commanders from all ten NUG regional commands met between August 3-6, 2026 and set out plans to shift from the 'People's Resistance War' posture toward a 'Strategic Offensive' phase, signaling an intent to consolidate gains and pursue more coordinated large-scale operations against junta forces.

media.caption: NUG/PDF commanders set plans to shift toward a 'Strategic Offensive' phase.
